targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", outcome="SERVER_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", outcome="CLIENT_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
topk(20, sum by (service, method, uri, status) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="comecome", service=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])))
